The manufacturer catalog identifies 10438 as the distally angled version of 10436, an aspiration biopsy needle for transbronchial biopsy, diameter 1.6 mm and working length 47 cm. The catalog illustration and short rigid instrument configuration support use as a rigid-bronchoscopy aspiration biopsy needle rather than a flexible-bronchoscope conventional TBNA needle.

The Ion Fully Articulating Catheter is the platform-specific robotic navigation catheter of the Ion Endoluminal System - the per-case robotic component analogous to the Monarch and Galaxy bronchoscopes classified as ROBOTIC_* in this cohort - not a generic navigation guide sheath.

Preferred: assign a platform-specific robotic catheter role (e.g., ROBOTIC_CATHETER or group with ROBOTIC_BRONCHOSCOPE per taxonomy convention). If NAV_CATHETER_GUIDE is retained, add an explicit compatibility constraint restricting it to the Intuitive Ion platform so it can never populate generic guide-sheath or ENB catheter slots.

decisions.reviewCohort: Targeted role correction — Hot Biopsy Forceps
decisions.rationale: Concur. Hot biopsy forceps are monopolar energy-enabled instruments requiring electrosurgical-platform compatibility (generator, return electrode, insulation) and are not interchangeable with cold biopsy forceps. BIOPSY_FORCEPS_ENERGY_ENABLED is correct; removing ordinary biopsy-forceps exact-slot options pending platform-compatibility evidence is appropriate.

The manufacturer catalog identifies 10435 A as a rigid puncture needle for histologic puncture biopsy, diameter 1.4 mm and working length 48 cm. It is specifically used through Karl Storz Instrument Guide 10329 A with HOPKINS Telescope 10320 AA and Universal Bronchoscopes 10318 B–D, sizes 8.5–6.5. It is not a flexible conventional TBNA needle.

BRK-S01 is listed in the Boston Scientific-distributed Scivita single-use bronchoscope system brochure as a “Bracket,” alongside the reusable HDVS-S300D Full HD Visualization Endoscopic Image Processor and the SBV single-use bronchoscope models. The brochure identifies Scivita Medical Technology as the manufacturer/registrant and Boston Scientific as the exclusive distributor.

The product image indicates that the bracket is used to mount or support the visualization processor/tablet on an equipment or IV pole. It is not an airway adapter, guiding catheter, or navigation-platform component.

Remove:
- GENERIC_AIRWAY_ADAPTER
- NAV_PLATFORM_ACCESSORY

Add:
- ENDOSCOPY_PROCESSOR_MOUNT_ACCESSORY

Add structured relationship:
- Accessory of / compatible with: Scivita HDVS-S300D Full HD Visualization Endoscopic Image Processor
Manufacturer and distributor fields

I would represent the entities separately:

Manufacturer:
Scivita Medical Technology (Suzhou) Co., Ltd.

Exclusive U.S. distributor:
Boston Scientific
Retain as catalog-only or room-equipment accessory. Do not place it in a per-case disposable airway-adapter, guiding-device, or navigation slot.
